family.description: Confirmatory cells that decide whether the repaired raw carry-less batch dispatch is adopted on Zen 3. The baseline arm links the pre-change crates, whose dispatch predicate requires AVX512VL and therefore runs the sequential PCLMULQDQ lane on this host; the candidate arm links the repaired crates, whose predicate reaches the 256-bit VPCLMULQDQ lane. Cells cover a small batch, an odd batch with a non-vector tail, an L1-resident batch, the FieldVec dot-product consumer with its packing and dispatch costs, and a streaming six-core sustained arm. No external comparator arm exists: an independent raw 64x64 carry-less batch product has no equivalent operation in the surveyed external libraries, whose carry-less kernels are long-polynomial multiplications.

effect.rationale: A two-wide VPCLMULQDQ lane replaces one PCLMULQDQ per product, so the hypothesis under test is that the raw batch gains at least a tenth of its time. The threshold sits above the pilot-measured resolution of 0.02 and below the two-fold ceiling a perfectly scaling two-wide lane could reach, so the family can distinguish a worthwhile gain from measurement noise.
effect.equivalence_rationale: The FieldVec dot product is called inside larger linear-algebra routines, where a regression up to five percent stays inside the variation those routines already carry. The margin exceeds the pilot-measured resolution of 0.02, so a cell declared not worse is an equivalence statement rather than an absence of significance.
effect.material_gap_rationale: Declared for completeness. No comparator-gap cell exists in this family because no external library exposes an independent raw carry-less batch product to compare against.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: The repair adds no kernel: it corrects the feature contract of an existing one and publishes the lane it selects. Sixty-five net production lines, most of them the safety and dispatch documentation the corrected contract requires, fit inside a budget of eighty.
